question: Under the not-all-equal law, does the cheapest growth equal parity's except at parity's closures (which relay into two-chain tails), and do bond tables determine who joins whom?

definitions.growth: FRESH-COUNT's policy and fewest counts (joinlib/fastlib), implied by SAT under not-all-equal (naelib) and structurally under parity
definitions.bond distance: least non-free set of distinctions holding both, minus one (bondlib, exact on stages of at most 15 distinctions)

public_inputs.run: scripts/longrun.py launch job.py (6 workers) under .venv/bin/python (pysat); python3 -B merge.py <out dir> <results.json>
public_inputs.reused: TOUCH-CENSUS-20261118-001B arrlib.py (enumeration); JOIN-GROWTH-20261118-001B joinlib.py, fastlib.py; FRESH-COUNT freelib (policy); BOND-NEXT-JOIN-20261117-001 check_rearrangements.py (reader control)

forbidden_inputs: Changing the law, the policy, a case or a prediction after reading any comparison; any difference is a failure, not a new exclusion
cheapest_meaningful_control: parity on the same starts by the same code; gates G1-G6 (checks.py, checks_output.json)

predictions.P2: parity closures relay: k (or k + 1) at T + k
predictions.P3: no not-all-equal junction implied; the lemma's hypotheses hold
predictions.P4: parity implies only the closing top
predictions.P5: pilot starts identical, lone knots by P2
predictions.B4: NAE collisions have a redundant junction
predictions.B5: NAE: no redundancy, same next joins
predictions.B5c: parity: some pair without redundancy joins differently

decision_rules.each: held iff no exception; B5c held iff such a pair exists

stop_rule: One run; read-out; referee hand-off; report.
disclosed_exploration: pilot (rings, chains, pairs, two-ring join, lone knots; three census shards; the first 30 part-B arrangements), recorded in the pre-registration

amendments.text: merge.py's B5c field reports 'every collision without a redundant junction joins alike' (false); the frozen decision rule says B5c holds iff such a pair joins differently, so B5c held (2,796 pairs). No code or data changed.
P-ring5-spare1 repeats the bare ring (bare_sizes gives four-place knots); the go-ahead's ring with one spare per knot is P-ring5-five-place. No case changed.
posthoc_b.py (added after the read-out) counts the presentations taking part in a collision and classifies each collision by states, redundancy and next joins; output artifacts/.../posthoc_b.json.
